The '''Kalarba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Hevvrol sector/Legends|Hevvrol sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]] and its two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Hosk]] and [[Indobok]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> The Kalarba system also contained the moon [[Keriba VI]]<ref name="Beneath Aucellis Park" /> and several [[Kalarba asteroid belts|asteroid belts]].<ref name="TEGtVaV" />

Following the [[Battle of Kalarba]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the Kalarba system became a [[Asteroid/Legends|shattered]], [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] and [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] wasteland that would remain uninhabitable for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="TNJOS" />
